evidence_spans.snippet: Either '0111100' or '0111101', can be selected as the slave address of SSD1306.
D/C# pin acts as SA0 for slave address selection.
The slave address is either 'b0111100' or 'b0111101' by changing the SA0 to LOW or HIGH
After VDD become stable, set RES# pin LOW (logic low) for at least 3us (t1) and then HIGH (logic high).
After VCC become stable, send command AFh for display ON. SEG/COM will be ON after 100ms (tAF).
Send command AEh for display OFF.
Wait for tOFF. Power OFF VDD .(where Minimum tOFF=0ms, Typical tOFF=100ms)
AEh, X[0]=0b:Display OFF (sleep mode) (RESET) AFh X[0]=1b:Display ON in normal mode
C0/C8 ... Set COM Output Scan Direction
DA A[5:4] ... Set COM Pins Hardware Configuration
D5 A[7:0] ... Set Display Clock Divide Ratio/Oscillator Frequency
DB A[6:4] ... Set VCOMH Deselect Level
Status Register Read ... D[6] : '1' for display OFF / '0' for display ON
The GDDRAM is a bit mapped static RAM holding the bit pattern to be displayed. The size of the RAM is 128 x 64 bits
the RAM is divided into eight pages, from PAGE0 to PAGE7
